oracle_cmd: sqlite3 -readonly ActivitiesCache.db "with a as (select rowid r, (select json_extract(value,'$.application') from json_each(AppId) where json_extract(value,'$.platform') in ('windows_win32','x_exe_path','windows_universal','packageId') order by case json_extract(value,'$.platform') when 'windows_win32' then 1 when 'x_exe_path' then 2 when 'windows_universal' then 3 else 4 end limit 1) n from Activity) select json_group_array(n) from (select n, min(r) m from a group by n order by m)"  (SQLite 3.53.1 CLI, JSON1)
